research_question: Under identical complete public facts and matched Bayes opportunity, how does native representation inductive bias affect finite-sample recovery across current, topology, history and interaction regimes?
target: D actual finish - original baseline finish >=120 minutes
public_authority: complete normalized cutoff P; identical facts; Static has timestamps; Temporal adds derived sequence organization only

training_protocol_anchor.initialization: pinned PyTorch reset_parameters; endpoint padding zero; fresh model/optimizer for each N
training_protocol_anchor.final_train_loss: sample-weighted mean online BCE of final epoch

exact_evaluation_policy.weights: 1/32 per validation or test public group
exact_evaluation_policy.logloss: secondary; q clipped to [1e-12,1-1e-12] only for log; expected -p log q -(1-p)log(1-q)
calibration: mean(abs(q-p)) named posterior MAE, not pure calibration
10 fixed equal-width q bins; sum bin_mass*abs(mean(q-p)|bin), empty bins0, rightmost includes1
exact_evaluation_policy.recovery_above_one: halt evaluator investigation if >1+1e-10; do not clip

negative_control_policy.rule: abs(mean paired INR difference)>.10 flags caution; simultaneous primary-family claims not invalidated automatically; descriptive95%CI contained in [-.10,.10] supports practical equivalence; otherwise inconclusive

O1_O2_policy: six co-primary contrasts, separate strata, no pooling, no dropping weak O1

StageC.formula: min R in grid with t_(1-.05/12,R-1)*max_j(s_j)*sqrt(5/chi2_(.20,5))/sqrt(R)<=.10; otherwise R32 flagged infeasible
StageC.above_cap: run fixed cap32 only with precision-limited label; never loosen margin, drop O1 or expand after StageC results

corpus_replication_policy.sampling: frozen route_and_retain train membership only; no label/topology/history balancing

initialization_replication_policy.shuffle: derive by stage/cell/corpus/init/N/epoch, omit family for shared example order

interval_method: paired corpus means; Student-t; initialization contrasts averaged before corpus SD; fixed interval method
multiplicity_policy: Bonferroni simultaneous95% CIs over six primary INR contrasts; superiority only if lower bound>0; material benefit only if lower bound>.10; no extra primary tests
validation_usage: 32 groups reserved; exact diagnostics only; no selection, no early stopping; StageV variance from development-only test-group evaluation
mechanism_diagnostics: future sequence-order logit sensitivity with no required sign
valid topology intervention affects message flow
health_gates: mechanism probes; no requirement to beat constant or Static

seed_namespace_policy.derivation: future registry-approved SHA256 domain-separated names into nonnegative63-bit seeds; reject all collisions with historical registries and each other before any run; freeze mapping once
seed_namespace_policy.mechanical_failure: invalidate/version full affected stage evidence and preregister replacement namespace; never replace for poor performance

corpus_artifact_policy.manifest: SHA256 canonical payloads, normalized public fingerprints, N-prefix indices, labels separate, seed registry reference
corpus_artifact_policy.leakage: cell/regime/O/coordinates/posterior only controller/evaluator metadata; input builder allowlist excludes them

optional_summaries: N50/N80 omitted to avoid nonmonotone crossing selection
secondary_contrasts: graph INR advantage IS1 minus IS0
temporal INR advantage IS2 minus IS0
temporal INR advantage IS3 minus IS1
all IS3 pairs including size control; descriptive only
failure_policy: retain failures; no complete-case confirmatory contrast if required paired run missing; incomplete StageC reported, no new seeds or winner stopping
realism: R-B/C7-B/O-B/NEXT-R2; expert deferred; no Temporal victory guarantee
